diagnostic.main_sampling: Deterministic uniform permutation of all TRAIN rows, without replacement across 20 batches; original inverse-cell BCE weights retained
diagnostic.scope: Native-style main sampling plus all five auxiliary axes and four operator/strength cases; fixed auxiliary-event diagnostic, not production-step frequencies

trigger.condition_rule: Either prespecified condition; both must have sufficient support and both are reported
trigger.interpretation: Engineering triage for a single ablation, not statistical evidence of causal harm

C1.only_objective_change: Response alignment absent; classification, hierarchical fairness, sensitivity and sham control retained
C1.selection: Earliest strict maximum clean FF++ validation AUC
C1.init: Same P50 encoder and fresh identical seed17 head; never initialize from trained H1

guardrails.secondary: All axes, worst-group AUC, FPR/FNR gaps, F_DP and es_AUC; show regressions
guardrails.point_favorable: Primary lower than H1, AUC no lower and FNR no higher; numerical screen only, not a noninferiority proof
